summary: I build medical AI that holds up on messy, incomplete patient data. My Ph.D. research at Georgia State targets what breaks multimodal models in practice: missing modalities, imbalanced classes, and predictions that ignore how a patient changes over time. At UST, I'm a Machine Learning Engineer II in the AI Center of Excellence, leading a 21-person team that ships agentic and RAG systems across healthcare, retail and finance.
